data.name: Game Of The Chosen
data.detailed_description:
Enter the terrifying and gripping horror escape game *Game of the Chosen*, which draws you into a dark and suspenseful world where every decision you make could be your last.

As a contestant in *Game of the Chosen*, you find yourself in a situation where the rules are simple, but the challenges are deadly. Your task is to navigate through various spaces – from simple rooms to complex networks of corridors – filled with puzzles, traps, and riddles that will test your ability to survive.

If you successfully complete one room, you'll move on to the next, with even more difficult challenges ahead. But you're not alone – ghosts and demons will constantly make your journey harder. These sinister opponents can manipulate both reality and you. They can shift you through time, and if you make a mistake while solving a puzzle, they can even cause you physical harm.

One of the most exciting features of *Game of the Chosen* is its dynamic gameplay. Every time you start the game, it offers a new experience – the tasks and maps are randomly generated, so you’ll never play the same game twice. Most objects in the levels are interactive, allowing you to influence your progress in various ways.

Navigate through rooms filled with puzzles and traps while ghosts and demons make your journey more difficult. Each game is unique, with randomly generated levels and interactive objects.
